paite: Pathian aw, nang ka Pathian na hi a; phalvak in ka hon zong hi; ka hinna nangmah duh in adangtak a; ka sa in ahon ngai ahi, gamkeu leh phaizang tui omlouhna ah.
heading: Judah Gamdai A Om Lai A. David La / Pathian Ngaihna
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mun siangthou ah ka hon en gige hi, na thilhihtheihna leh na thupina mu ding in.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

paite: Na zahngaihna ka hinna sang a ahoih zawk ziak in ka muk in ahon phat ding hi.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

paite: Huchi mah bang in ka damsung teng in ka hon phat ding a; na min in ka khutte ka zak ding hi.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

paite: Ka hinna guhngek leh thau a atai bang in atai ding a; ka kam in kipahna mukpu in ahon phat ding hi.
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

paite: Ka lupna tung a ka hon theihgige lai in, zan a na tungtang thu ka lunggel lai in.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

paite: Nang hon panpihpa na hi a, na kha nuai ah nuam in la ka sa ding hi.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

paite: Ka hinna in hon zui tettet a, na khut taklam in na hon kai zel hi.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte lei mun nuainung ah alut ding ua;
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

paite: Namsau thilhihtheihna in apuk ding ua; sehalte tan ahi ding uhi.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

paite: Kumpipa bel Pathian ah anuam ding a; amah lou a kichiam peuhmah in asuang ding ua, zuauhat kamte hum a om ding ahih ziak in.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
